autonomy_levels.A0: Observe, test or report only; no business action.
autonomy_levels.A1: Analyze, retrieve, score, draft or recommend.
autonomy_levels.A2: Create action proposals or reversible workflow changes; approval/policy required.
autonomy_levels.A3: Deterministic low-risk execution only when explicitly authorized; never high-impact LLM authority.
autonomy_levels.A4: High-impact final action; prohibited for generative agents.
